title: On a 320 px phone the 'changed on another phone' notice is hidden under the header after the reload
steps: Phone A (390) and phone B (320x568) open /round/579ae075098281d89c967fb0?edit=1
B, scrolled to the rows (the keypad covers the lower half), changes Maya 2 / Dan 4 > Save changes > confirm
expected: B sees the refusal message next to the reloaded numbers
actual: 409 is handled and the form reloads A's numbers, but the page keeps scrollY 142 and the notice sits at top 23-38 px, under the ~68 px sticky header. B's screen shows only the numbers snapping back; nothing visible says why. At 390 the notice is visible.
why_it_matters: The data is safe, but the editor on a small phone does not learn that someone else changed the round, and the natural reaction is to type the values again and save, overwriting the other admin knowingly-blind.
suggested_fix: After a 409 reload scroll the notice into view (or show it as a toast/banner fixed below the header).

title: 'Last session' caption repeats the date for default-named sessions
steps: Start a session without a name (it becomes 'Thursday, 19 Nov'), play a round, close it
why_it_matters: Reads like a stutter; small polish.
suggested_fix: Omit the date when the name is the default date name.

title: Renege net preview wraps to three lines at 320 px and spaces the minus inconsistently
steps: Results step, enter tricks, tap Renege for a player at 320 px
actual: 'bid 5 · made +35 / − 100 renege / = −65' over three lines; '− 100' has a space after the minus while '−65' does not
why_it_matters: Polish only; the meaning is clear.
suggested_fix: Write '−100' without the space; consider 'made +35 · renege −100 = −65'.
